title: Performance & Cold-Start Qualification
objective: Prove the Development Engine is both SAFE and FAST by enforcing bounded timing/cost/context budgets, detecting unnecessary validation, qualifying proof reuse, cold-start and recovery, and proving R3 work cannot bypass strengthened assurance.

tasks.description: Define and qualify T0/T1/T2 timing budgets.
Detect unnecessary validation checks and redundant work.
Prove mandatory execution cost remains zero.
Prove critical R3 work cannot bypass strengthened assurance.

done_when: T0 T1 and routine T2 have explicit measured fail-closed timing budgets
unnecessary validation work is detected rather than silently tolerated
proof reuse measurably avoids safe redundant work without weakening exact-input binding
mandatory path requires zero paid API SaaS LLM or larger runner
fresh agents pass bounded context-free cold-start qualification
interrupted work resumes from permanent state and active AWU without chat history
R3 work cannot bypass T3/T4 requirements
Development Engine receives both SAFE and FAST verdicts before ENG-09
